items.assessment: Conditional/revise. A CNN plus standard few-shot prototypes or replay alone would be too close to coursework. A defensible thesis needs the preregistered class-incremental forgetting/unknown-rejection study, a carefully audited equivalence policy for visually indistinguishable symbols, multiple class orders and memory budgets, and comparison with established incremental methods. The original writer-transfer claim is withdrawn because contributor IDs cannot support it. Direct October evidence for this exact question was not found; recent handwriting/OCR sources are adjacent corroboration, not proof of a new gap. Do not endorse until the eligible-class/ambiguity audit and closer incremental-learning literature review support this scope.
items.unresolved: Complete the small archive during an authorised experiment phase, verify hashes/image shapes and sufficient examples per class. Reconcile visually indistinguishable semantic labels before training.
items.kill_test: Audit class counts, exact image duplicates and label equivalence; require usable base/new/unknown partitions and enough query images after support selection. Withdraw any personalisation or unseen-writer wording. If all observed errors are label ambiguity, revise the objective toward top-k ambiguity handling rather than forced accuracy.

items.assessment: Conditional/revise. Context stratification and generic calibration are established techniques and do not by themselves establish a master's contribution. The substantial version must isolate why a frozen tabular foundation model changes with context composition, compare learned correction against analytic prior correction and strong tree models under identical label/CPU budgets, and retain all preregistered conditions. Two datasets support a bounded mechanism study, not broad model superiority. CPU feasibility and whether a nontrivial adaptation question remains are still untested; withdraw if a routine prior correction answers the entire question.
items.unresolved: Audit duplicates and feature types; exclude PageValues from any prospective purchasing prediction because it may encode post-outcome information. The month variable does not permit an exact chronological split.
items.kill_test: Run the bounded CPU/memory preflight, verify context/query disjointness and quantify minority-class coverage. Withdraw if no feasible context configuration exists; revise if gains vanish against analytic prior correction or only appear with PageValues.

items.assessment: Conditional/revise. Training matrix factorisation and LightGCN and comparing accuracy on a random MovieLens split would be coursework. A substantial version needs an independently designed small-history adapter, strict new-user/global-time separation, timestamp-tie sensitivity, all-catalogue ranking and the relevance/popularity/coverage trade-off at matched compute and label access. Data feasibility is demonstrated, but the model study and its scientific value are not. Historical selected users limit external validity. Commercial use and redistribution are not permitted by the inspected dataset terms without separate permission.
items.unresolved: Finalize support-item eligibility, validation-user separation, positive-rating threshold, timestamp-tie handling and exact release attribution.
items.kill_test: Reproduce the verified feasible cohort after support/catalogue filtering, audit time/user separation and run a small CPU fit. Require enough independent users per popularity stratum. Revise if gains disappear under tied-event handling or if catalogue coverage collapses; do not claim online benefit.
